name: Simplex Castings Limited
about: Simplex Castings Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of castings and equipment worldwide. The company offers bed plate/surface plates and machine tools, including bed/floor plate, surface plates, angle blocks, marking tables, t-slotted rails, and welding plates; sinter and pellet cars; cement and crushing plants comprising large gears, ball mill parts, coal and vertical mill parts, pre-calciner kiln parts, rotary kiln parts, shafts, and crusher components; and pump jacks that include well equipment and well simulation equipment, as well as onshore drilling rigs. It also provides steel plant equipment; sugar plant products, such as feed rollers, roller mill and gear parts, sugar melter pan, drum and wheel assemblies, and settling and molasses storage tanks; coke oven doors and assemblies; and earth-moving equipment, including carrier planetary, dipper handles, sprocket and hub castings, bucket assemblies, boom points, earth mover hub castings, center axle housings, axle housings, and brake drums; and corrugated, round, slab, and sq. ingot molds, as well as trumpets, base plates, and counterweights. In addition, the company offers railway products comprising Co-Co, flexi coil, concor, and casnub bogies, as well as truck frames and suspension tubes. Further, it provides power plant products, such as gate and swing check valves, butterfly valves, fabricated pump elements, and other turbine components, as well as turbine, volute, and pump casings. Additionally, the company undertakes turnkey projects. It serves steel, railway, power, mining, cement, sugar, chemical, earthmovers, machine tools, ship building, oil and gas, and defense industries. Simplex Castings Limited was founded in 1970 and is based in Bhilai, India.
